reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Atlassian User Interface (https://aui.atlassian.com/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: Avatars 文档列出 Summary、Status、Examples 等段落，屏幕下方显示多种尺寸的头像预览与相关用法信息。

Visual details from source observation: 首屏是一块居中 hero，标题 Atlassian User Interface，说明写 AUI is a tailor-made frontend library for creating a user interface according to the Atlassian Design Guidelines，下面一个 Get started 按钮；再往下并排两张插画卡，Documentation 卡挂着 Latest user guide 11.0、Upgrade guides、Archived guides 三条链接，Resources 卡是 Get started with AUI 11.0 与 Check out a few ways to consume AUI。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
